features.name: QQ social identity through AstrBot and OneBot v1
features.description: Let the desktop pet treat an allowlisted QQ small account as its own persistent social identity while AstrBot/NapCat only transport OneBot messages.
dependencies: existing Tencent Cloud AstrBot + NapCatQQ/OneBot v11 deployment
a private Tailscale tailnet or separate cloud and desktop bearer-token environment variables
scope: Keep the desktop project's LLM, persona, memory, and safety boundaries as the sole conversation brain
Queue inbound OneBot text events in AstrBot and poll them from the desktop without a public desktop callback
Expose a disabled-by-default QQ identity configuration page and bounded local audit records
Support a private-tailnet-only bridge mode while retaining the original bearer-token mode
Allow only explicit desktop text-send instructions to previously routed allowlisted targets
Never persist QQ credentials, tokens, QR codes, sessions, or plugin queue data in the repository
done_criteria: Text bridge is deployed and manually verified against the user's cloud AstrBot/NapCat instance
Allowlist, offline expiry, local-audit clearing, and tool blocking are exercised end to end
QQ media workflow and autonomous outreach policy are separately designed and verified before enablement
